name: Glide Select
description: Custom dropdown select with a pop-in menu and a highlight pill that glides between options. Supports keyboard navigation, typeahead, pointer scrubbing, optional tags and auto-flipping placement.
contents: Trigger button showing the selected label or placeholder with a chevron
Popup listbox of options with optional right-aligned tag text and a tick on the selected row
Sliding highlight pill behind the options
behavior: Menu pops with scale and fade, and flips to the opposite side when it would overflow the viewport
Highlight pill glides to the hovered or active row
Press, drag and release on the list picks the row under the pointer
Arrow keys, Home, End, Enter, Space, Escape, Tab and typeahead work from the trigger
Selected label blurs in briefly after a pointer pick
editableByProps: Options, labels, tags, selected value and placeholder
Surface, highlight, text and tick colors
Size preset, corner radius, menu width, placement and alignment
Pop and glide durations, highlight memory, disabled state, aria label

needsCodeEdit.change: Change trigger or row dimensions and font sizes beyond the presets
Swap the chevron or tick icons
needsCodeEdit.where: HugeiconsIcon elements using ArrowDown01Icon and Tick02Icon

needsCodeEdit.change: Change gap between trigger and menu
needsCodeEdit.where: MENU_GAP constant and the data-[side=...] top/bottom classes on the menu div

fixed: Uses 'use client' and browser APIs, so it must render on the client
Renders inline (inline-block) with no frame, placed wherever the parent puts it
Menu is absolutely positioned inside the root, so overflow-hidden ancestors can clip it
Menu width is fixed in px via menuWidth, minimum is the trigger width
Document pointerdown listener is added only while open and removed on close or unmount
Default colors are dark, so it needs a dark surface or custom color props on light pages
Option values must be unique since they are used as keys
